chapter: Growing up with music in Austin
title: Warm-Up Ramey and taking the tuba job from a football coach
summary: He starred in basketball but warmed the football bench, apparently because he took the coach's tuba job in the Royal Aces.

But then we got it to working down, pretty good. And I began -- now my teacher -- now, I played football and basketball. I was like a star on the basketball team.
Yeah, I'd run between the guys.

Fast. Lightning, you know. But on the football team, I'm still known as Warm-Up Ramey. This coach would -- he always gave me some pants that were too big for me. And just about two minutes before the game would end, he'd holler, "Ramey, Warm Up," and I'd be running down the sideline, and never got in the game.
So they called me Warm-up Ramey.
Well, why was that, you weren't big enough?
Well, I don't know. I kind of came to the conclusion -- see, I had taken his job away from him in this jazz band.
